kind.instructions: Which Anvilmark coding-task kind best describes the work requested in task_summary? Use the primary deliverable.

criteria.architecture: Design component boundaries, interfaces, or system structure.
criteria.bug: Correct existing behavior that fails or behaves incorrectly.
criteria.feature: Add a new capability or observable behavior.
criteria.refactor: Change internal structure while preserving intended behavior.
criteria.test: Add or improve checks that verify behavior; tests are the main deliverable.
criteria.review: Inspect existing work and report findings; no implementation is requested.

risk.instructions: Based only on the described scope, what is the risk if this coding task is implemented incorrectly? Choose medium when the description lacks enough detail to justify low or high.

criteria.low: Narrow, easily reversible change with limited impact and a clear check.
criteria.medium: Several components or users may be affected, or impact is not fully specified.
criteria.high: Security, privacy, money, data integrity, production availability, or difficult rollback may be affected.
